page.overview:
Who is Alejandro González Iñárritu?

Alejandro González Iñárritu is a Mexican filmmaker. He makes his first and only appearance in "¡The Fall Guy-Yi-Yi!"

He is voiced by his real-life counterpart.

When Bumblebee Man was about to quit his show business, Alejandro González Iñárritu was standing on a porch and wanted him to do his film, which he wrote the film, Bee-va Mexico. However, he had no idea that the stunt double for Bumblebee Man was actually Homer Simpson. When Bumblebee Man told Alejandro that Homer would be doing his own stunt, Alejandro was shocked and considered canceling the film, but Bumblebee Man handed Homer a green mask and carried on to start the film.

When the news broke out that Bumblebee Man had used a stunt double, he decided to perform his dangerous stunt by falling steps on film at Teotihuacan. When the Simpson family arrived, Alejandro asked Homer to talk with Pedro, knowing he was the only one Pedro would listen to, while the crew set up the camera equipment. Homer then approached Pedro and asked Alejandro if he could coordinate with the transport department to arrange a trip to the top of the pyramid.
